description.zh: 文件名需带文件类型后缀
description.en: The filename must include the file extension.

description.zh:
fileUrl/fileUrlObject二选一：

- fileUrl：以文档URL方式使用，单个文档（支持1000页以内、100MB以内的文档）

- fileUrlObject：以本地文件上传方式调用接口时使用，单个文档（支持1000页以内、100 MB以内的文档）

> 支持格式如下：
> - bmp, jpe, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, webp, heic
description.en:
Choose either fileUrl or fileUrlObject.

- fileUrl: The URL of a single document. The document can have up to 1,000 pages and be up to 100 MB in size.

- fileUrlObject: The local file to upload when you call the API. The document can have up to 1,000 pages and be up to 100 MB in size.

> Supported formats:
>
> - bmp, jpe, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, webp, heic

description.zh:
语言，可传参数
- zh-CN：中文（默认）
- en-US：英语
description.en: The unique ID of the extraction template, which specifies the content to extract from the document. To obtain the ID, log on to the template management page and configure a template.

description.zh: 唯一的抽取模板ID，用于指定文档要抽取的内容，需登录模板管理页面配置模板后获取对应的模板ID。
description.en: The unique ID of the extraction template, which specifies the content to extract from the document. To obtain the ID, log on to the template management page and configure a template.

descriptions.zh: 用户通过上传文档url，获取VL实时返回结果。
descriptions.en: You can upload a document URL to retrieve real-time results from VL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun energyexpertexternal analyze-vl-realtime --file-url fileUrl:_https://example.com/example.pdf_fileUrlObject:_FileInputStream_generated_from_a_local_file --file-name test.png --template-id 572d24k0c95a --biz-language zh-CN --region cn-hangzhou
